Name: Hothir, Son of Heman
Summary: Son of Heman the king's seer, one and twentieth lot for song.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:4; 1 Chronicles 25:28: Son of Heman the king's seer, one and twentieth lot for song.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Hothir stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
